T-095: ask a job to stop. Work that has not started stops now; work in flight stops
at its next checkpoint, so nothing is left half-written.

T-250: ask a job to pause at its next pausable checkpoint (queued/waiting-input work
pauses immediately, since nothing is running). Not every job type offers one — a
handler with no pausable checkpoint simply runs to completion.

T-250: requeue a paused job. The handler decides for itself, from its own
checkpoint, how much of its earlier work it can skip rather than redo.
F-075: several constructive answers to one request, each a preview to pick from.

checkpoint that skips the reconstruction step on resume — see the job's
`checkpoint_stage` for which kind this is. Exterior (COLMAP) jobs offer no checkpoint
at all; photo-room COLMAP jobs have the same boundary. Pausing one before it starts
running still works (it just never gets
claimed), but pausing one already running is rejected with 409, since the job cannot
actually honour the request once it is in flight.

AIHistoryItem.title: AIHistoryItem
AIHistoryItem.description: T-048: what the conversational edit history UI renders per turn.

AdaptMaterialBody.title: AdaptMaterialBody
AdaptMaterialBody.description: F-009: the material the part will be printed in; the plan adapts to it.

AdviceBody.title: AdviceBody
AdviceBody.description: A question about the part, or nothing — then the engineer reviews the whole part.

BevelEdgesOp.title: BevelEdgesOp
BevelEdgesOp.description:
`width_mm` is how far the bevel reaches along each adjoining face. One segment is a
straight chamfer; more segments round it into a fillet of that reach.

BoxRegion.title: BoxRegion
BoxRegion.description: An axis-aligned volume in world millimetres — what a rectangular drag becomes.

ConvertBody.title: ConvertBody
ConvertBody.description: `format` is one of the exportable ids from GET /formats.

CutPlaneBody.title: CutPlaneBody
CutPlaneBody.description: On an axis at a coordinate or a fraction of the extent, or anywhere by point + normal.

DetailOp.title: DetailOp
DetailOp.description: A dimensioned feature on a flat patch of the surface, raised from it or cut into it.

EditCreate.title: EditCreate
EditCreate.description: Operations are validated against the same registry the planner is held to.

EnclosureBody.title: EnclosureBody
EnclosureBody.description: A case around a component from the catalogue; every number is a plan parameter.

sill_mm.title: Sill Mm
sill_mm.description: Window sill height (default 900). Doors start at floor level: omit or 0.

floor.title: Floor
floor.description: Optional 1-based floor address. When present, sill_mm is measured from that floor; when absent, sill_mm remains the legacy absolute facade height.

FeedbackReason.title: FeedbackReason
FeedbackReason.description: Only set when `rating == bad` (F-self-learning step 2's short reason list).

FinalizeBody.title: FinalizeBody
FinalizeBody.description:
The object's largest dimension, if the user or the device knows it (T-082), plus the
reconstruction choices from the pre-processing screen (method/quality/texture/mask).

GameExport.title: GameExport
GameExport.description: F-077: what a game engine gets (the worker validates the same fields again).

HouseTextRequestBody.title: HouseTextRequestBody
HouseTextRequestBody.description: The canonical request a text proposal may produce: whole mm, bounded shape, no stair.

Knurl.title: Knurl
Knurl.description: V-grooves cut into the surface: one set (straight) or two crossing sets (diamond).

LassoRegion.title: LassoRegion
LassoRegion.description:
A freehand outline, projected onto one plane of the model.

The polygon is 2-D in the plane's own axes (the two that are not `axis`), at the
plane's offset along `axis`, extruded through `depth_mm`. That is exactly what a finger
or a pencil draws on a face, and it is enough for the kernel to work with.

ListingBody.title: ListingBody
ListingBody.description: What goes on the shelf: the project's head (or a kept version), under a licence.

Measurements.title: Measurements
Measurements.description: Caliper readings in mm; any subset — the rest simply is not learned.

MeshEditBody.title: MeshEditBody
MeshEditBody.description:
Operations run in order on the version's mesh. Selections carry millimetre coordinates
(one point per vertex, two per edge, three per face), not indices; the operation shapes are
the worker's `EditRequest` and are checked before anything is queued.

MethodsOut.title: MethodsOut
MethodsOut.description: Which ways in this server offers, so a client shows only what works.

OptimizeModelBody.title: OptimizeModelBody
OptimizeModelBody.description: F-007: what to optimize for. `lighter` hollows the part to a wall the material carries.

PhotoReport.title: PhotoReport
PhotoReport.description: A report with photos of the print: a vision model adds the symptoms it can see.

ProvenanceGraphOut.title: ProvenanceGraphOut
ProvenanceGraphOut.description: F-079: the versions, the commands, the scans, the origins and the derived work.

RegionSelection.title: RegionSelection
RegionSelection.description: What the client sends with a prompt: where, and on what.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.description: One or more user-measured millimetre dimensions; unspecified values are unknown.

ReplacementPartCapture.title: ReplacementPartCapture
ReplacementPartCapture.description: Bounded evidence for camera → replacement-part planning.

ReplacementPartViews.title: ReplacementPartViews
ReplacementPartViews.description: Four user-labelled sides; labels are evidence, not inferred camera poses.

Ribs.title: Ribs
Ribs.description: Parallel bars (raised) or grooves (recessed) running along the area's length.

RollbackBody.title: RollbackBody
RollbackBody.description: What to go back to, in the user's words: "два часа назад", "v3", "before the hole".

RoomRequirement.title: RoomRequirement
RoomRequirement.description:
One typed room requested by the quick-plan composer.

Areas are hard constraints, not suggestions: accepting an impossible composition and
silently producing differently-sized rooms would make the range controls misleading.

RotateOp.title: RotateOp
RotateOp.description: Rotate selected components around a world axis through their selected bounds centre.

ScaleOp.title: ScaleOp
ScaleOp.description: Scale selected components around the centre of their selected bounding box.

ScanMode.title: ScanMode
ScanMode.description: How the frames were captured — what the device could actually do (T-074).

Selection.title: Selection
Selection.description: Picked components as millimetre coordinates: 1 point per vertex, 2 per edge, 3 per face.

SessionOut.title: SessionOut
SessionOut.description: What a client keeps: the token, who it is, where to open.

SlidingLidBody.title: SlidingLidBody
SlidingLidBody.description: Open box with retaining guide lips and a separate lid sliding along platform +Y.

Stroke.title: Stroke
Stroke.description: One swipe of colour. Without a region it covers the whole body.

Units.title: Units
Units.description: Canonical unit inside the platform is millimetres; others only at the boundary.

VersionSnapshot.title: VersionSnapshot
VersionSnapshot.description: One side of a comparison: the numbers a user reads off the screen.
